name: Arcfin Sync
description: Syncs Arcfin app settings across a user's devices, scoped by platform. Gives the admin lock, unlock, and prefill control per setting from the Jellyfin dashboard. Adds notifications for new media, admin announcements, and Seerr request availability.
overview: Settings sync and notifications for Arcfin.

versions.changelog: Fixed the plugin targeting the wrong Jellyfin ABI (was 10.9.0.0/net8.0, now 12.1.0.0/net10.0), which caused a Malfunctioned status on real servers. Removed an unnecessary FrameworkReference the plugin loader rejects. Replaced the free-form Locked Settings table with a real Client Settings editor mirroring the app's own Settings hierarchy. seerrUsername is now derived from Seerr Account Type's lock state instead of being independently lockable. Switched dashboard tab navigation to Jellyfin's real multi-page mechanism.
